records.title: Lint warning baseline and budget
records.goal: turn an existing warning backlog into a measured, non-growing budget
detect: Inventory configured compilers, linters, warning-as-error gates, and suppression files.
Separate pre-existing diagnostics from warnings introduced by the current change.
records.fix: Remove safe high-confidence warnings first and encode a ratcheting baseline without disabling rules.
records.verify: Run the repository's configured diagnostic commands twice and compare counts by rule and path.
records.stop: Stop if the proposed baseline would hide new diagnostics or change generated and vendored files.

records.title: Dead code and unused symbol removal
records.goal: remove unreachable code and unused symbols without deleting runtime-discovered behavior
detect: Combine compiler or linter diagnostics with call-site, export, reflection, plugin, and configuration searches.
Mark code as proven unused, dynamically reachable, or uncertain.
records.fix: Delete only proven-unused code and update tests, exports, and documentation that referenced it.
records.verify: Build and run focused tests plus any plugin, reflection, serialization, or registration checks.
records.stop: Stop on dynamic loading, public API compatibility, reflection, generated registration, or unclear ownership.

records.title: Duplicated logic consolidation
records.goal: consolidate behaviorally equivalent logic while preserving each caller's contract
detect: Find structurally similar blocks and compare inputs, outputs, side effects, and error semantics.
Reject textually similar code whose business rules or lifecycle differ.
records.fix: Extract the smallest shared unit and keep caller-specific policy at the call sites.
records.verify: Run tests for every former copy and add a characterization test for the shared invariant.
records.stop: Stop when consolidation would merge distinct authorization, tenancy, transaction, or compatibility rules.

records.title: Complexity and long-function reduction
records.goal: reduce hard-to-review control flow without changing behavior
detect: Use configured complexity diagnostics and inspect nesting, early exits, state mutation, and mixed responsibilities.
Capture observable behavior before choosing extraction boundaries.
records.fix: Extract cohesive pure or side-effect-bounded units and simplify control flow in reviewable increments.
records.verify: Run characterization tests and compare outputs, exceptions, side effects, and performance-sensitive paths.
records.stop: Stop if behavior is untested, timing-dependent, protocol-sensitive, or requires a public API redesign.

records.title: Deterministic test and flake remediation
records.goal: remove nondeterminism from a reproducibly flaky test
detect: Reproduce with repeated, shuffled, isolated, and parallel runs while recording seed and environment.
Classify clock, randomness, shared state, network, filesystem, ordering, or concurrency causes.
records.fix: Control the identified nondeterministic boundary instead of adding retries or broad sleeps.
records.verify: Run the focused test repeatedly under the triggering mode and then run the containing suite.
records.stop: Stop if the failure cannot be reproduced or the fix would weaken assertions or mask a product race.

records.title: Test isolation and fixture hygiene
records.goal: eliminate order-dependent fixtures and leaked test state
detect: Run tests alone and in varied order while tracking global, database, filesystem, environment, and mock state.
Identify fixtures whose setup or cleanup is implicit, shared, or broader than the test.
records.fix: Make ownership explicit, scope fixtures narrowly, and restore every mutated boundary deterministically.
records.verify: Run randomized-order, parallel where supported, focused, and full-suite checks.
records.stop: Stop before deleting persistent fixtures or touching shared external environments without operator approval.

records.title: Deprecated API migration
records.goal: replace deprecated APIs using the repository's supported runtime versions
detect: Collect compiler and runtime deprecations and confirm the installed and minimum supported versions.
Find wrappers, downstream callers, serialization contracts, and documented compatibility promises.
records.fix: Use the documented replacement with the smallest compatibility-preserving adapter necessary.
records.verify: Build against supported version bounds and run focused behavior and compatibility tests.
records.stop: Stop if the replacement requires dropping a supported runtime or changing a public contract.

records.title: Configuration validation and default hygiene
records.goal: make invalid configuration fail clearly and defaults behave consistently
detect: Trace configuration sources, precedence, parsing, coercion, defaults, and startup failure behavior.
Identify ambiguous empty, missing, zero, false, and null states.
records.fix: Centralize typed validation and preserve documented precedence and backward-compatible defaults.
records.verify: Test valid, missing, malformed, boundary, and conflicting configuration inputs.
records.stop: Stop if changing a default could alter production behavior or requires secret values to test.

records.title: Structured logging and cardinality hygiene
records.goal: make logs structured, actionable, and bounded without exposing sensitive data
detect: Inventory free-form interpolation, inconsistent event names, high-cardinality fields, and duplicate error logs.
Trace exception ownership so one failure is not logged repeatedly at every layer.
records.fix: Use stable event fields, bounded identifiers, and a single accountable logging boundary.
records.verify: Assert event shape, severity, redaction behavior, and cardinality-safe field values in focused tests.
records.stop: Stop on live log access, uncertain data classification, or telemetry schema changes needing owner approval.

records.title: Feature flag and experiment cleanup
records.goal: remove stale feature-flag branches after rollout state is proven
detect: Find flag definitions, readers, defaults, tests, analytics, rollout records, and operational ownership.
Require evidence that the selected branch is permanent in every deployed environment.
records.fix: Remove the inactive branch, flag plumbing, stale tests, and configuration in one bounded change.
records.verify: Test the permanent behavior and search for remaining flag keys, aliases, and configuration references.
records.stop: Stop without authoritative rollout state or when rollback still depends on the flag.

records.title: TODO, FIXME, and suppression debt
records.goal: turn stale annotations and diagnostic suppressions into owned, reviewable work
detect: Inventory TODO, FIXME, disabled-rule, ignore, pragma, and expected-failure annotations with history.
Classify resolved, actionable, policy-required, generated, and unexplained entries.
records.fix: Delete resolved annotations, narrow justified suppressions, and add owner or issue context where policy permits.
records.verify: Run the affected diagnostics and confirm no suppression scope expanded.
records.stop: Stop if removing a suppression reveals unsafe behavior that needs a dedicated remediation recipe.

records.title: Time, date, timezone, and clock hygiene
records.goal: make temporal logic explicit, testable, and timezone-safe
detect: Find direct wall-clock reads, naive timestamps, local-time assumptions, duration math, and implicit timezone conversion.
Separate monotonic duration measurement from civil time and persistence.
records.fix: Inject or wrap clocks at testable boundaries and normalize stored and transmitted time deliberately.
records.verify: Test daylight-saving transitions, timezone offsets, leap boundaries, and controlled clock advancement.
records.stop: Stop if changing timestamp representation would require a data migration or external contract change.

records.title: Serialization schema and versioning hygiene
records.goal: make serialized contracts explicit and backward-compatible
detect: Inventory encoders, decoders, schema files, field aliases, defaults, and persisted payload versions.
Identify implicit field renames, lossy coercion, unknown-field behavior, and unstable ordering assumptions.
records.fix: Add explicit version handling and compatibility-preserving field behavior at the serialization boundary.
records.verify: Round-trip current fixtures and read representative prior-version payloads.
records.stop: Stop if compatibility requirements or migration ownership are unknown.

records.title: Regular-expression correctness and complexity hygiene
records.goal: make complex regular expressions bounded, readable, and behaviorally tested
detect: Find nested quantifiers, ambiguous alternation, catastrophic backtracking risk, and undocumented capture dependencies.
Collect representative valid, invalid, adversarial, and maximum-length inputs.
records.fix: Simplify or replace risky expressions while preserving explicit matching and capture contracts.
records.verify: Run positive, negative, boundary, Unicode, and adversarial performance tests.
records.stop: Stop if the expression implements an undocumented protocol or security boundary requiring specialist review.

records.title: Unicode, locale, and normalization hygiene
records.goal: make text comparison and normalization semantics intentional
detect: Trace case conversion, normalization, collation, length, slicing, identifier, and display operations.
Identify locale-dependent behavior and byte-versus-code-point assumptions.
records.fix: Normalize only at documented boundaries and use locale-aware or locale-independent operations deliberately.
records.verify: Test composed and decomposed text, non-ASCII case, grapheme clusters, and configured locales.
records.stop: Stop if normalization affects identifiers, authentication, signatures, or stored keys without a migration plan.

records.title: Dependency manifest and lockfile hygiene
records.goal: align declared, resolved, direct, optional, and unused dependencies without upgrading them
detect: Compare manifests, lockfiles, workspace definitions, imports, build plugins, scripts, and deployment packaging.
Classify direct, transitive, optional, platform, development, and apparently unused dependencies.
records.fix: Remove only proven-unused declarations and regenerate lock metadata with the repository's pinned toolchain.
records.verify: Perform frozen or locked installs, builds, tests, and package-content checks.
records.stop: Stop before version upgrades, provenance changes, registry changes, or removal of dynamically loaded packages.

records.title: TypeScript strictness and escape-hatch debt
records.goal: reduce unsafe any, ignore directives, assertions, and disabled strict checks incrementally
detect: Read the effective tsconfig graph and inventory any, unknown casts, non-null assertions, and ignore directives.
Group diagnostics by boundary so generated declarations and external types remain separate.
records.fix: Replace escape hatches with narrowed types, guards, or explicit boundary adapters without broad config changes.
records.verify: Run the repository's exact TypeScript build and type-test commands with no new suppressions.
records.stop: Stop if strictness changes would alter emitted code, public declarations, or unsupported consumers.

records.title: JavaScript promise, abort, and listener lifecycle
records.goal: close floating promises, lost failures, uncancelled work, and leaked event listeners
detect: Trace promise creation, awaiting, rejection ownership, AbortSignal propagation, and listener registration/removal.
Find fire-and-forget work without an explicit owner or terminal error handler.
records.fix: Attach work to an owning lifecycle, propagate cancellation, and pair every listener with deterministic cleanup.
records.verify: Test success, rejection, cancellation, timeout, teardown, and repeated mount or invocation paths.
records.stop: Stop if changing concurrency or event ordering could affect external protocols without characterization tests.

records.title: JavaScript module cycles, side effects, and unused exports
records.goal: make module initialization order and public exports predictable
detect: Build the import graph and inspect cycles, barrel files, side-effect imports, package exports, and unused symbols.
Distinguish runtime registration imports from accidental side effects.
records.fix: Break cycles at a stable dependency boundary and remove only exports proven private and unused.
records.verify: Run builds in supported module modes and test startup, tree-shaking, and package import paths.
records.stop: Stop on plugin registration, bundler-specific behavior, or public package exports without compatibility evidence.

records.title: React hook, effect, and state lifecycle
records.goal: remove stale closures, redundant state, and effect cleanup defects
detect: Inspect dependency arrays, derived state, effect ownership, subscriptions, async work, and Strict Mode behavior.
Separate event-driven work from synchronization effects.
records.fix: Move logic to render or events where appropriate and give remaining effects symmetric setup and cleanup.
records.verify: Test remount, dependency change, cancellation, Strict Mode development behavior, and user-visible state.
records.stop: Stop if changing state ownership requires product or component API redesign.

records.title: Node.js stream, emitter, and handle lifecycle
records.goal: prevent stream stalls, duplicate listeners, and handles that keep processes alive
detect: Trace stream backpressure, pipeline errors, listener counts, timers, sockets, and handle close ownership.
Find manual pipe chains and emitter listeners without terminal cleanup.
records.fix: Use lifecycle-aware stream composition and close, unref, or unsubscribe handles at the owning boundary.
records.verify: Test partial reads, errors, aborts, slow consumers, repeated startup, and clean process termination.
records.stop: Stop if changing buffering or event ordering could violate a protocol or throughput requirement.

records.title: Python typing Any and ignore debt
records.goal: narrow Any, casts, and type-ignore suppressions at trusted boundaries
detect: Read the configured type checker and inventory explicit Any, implicit Any, casts, and ignore codes.
Separate untyped third-party boundaries from application-owned types.
records.fix: Add precise annotations, protocols, overloads, or runtime narrowing without annotation-only lies.
records.verify: Run the configured type checker and focused runtime tests with no broader ignores.
records.stop: Stop if the change requires falsifying runtime behavior or publishing incompatible type declarations.

records.title: Python mutable-default, dataclass, and sentinel hygiene
records.goal: remove shared mutable defaults and ambiguous sentinel values
detect: Find mutable parameter and field defaults, reused class state, and None overloaded as both data and absence.
Inspect dataclass equality, ordering, frozen, slots, and default_factory behavior.
records.fix: Use factories or private sentinels while preserving signatures, serialization, and equality contracts.
records.verify: Test repeated construction, mutation isolation, omitted versus explicit null values, and serialization.
records.stop: Stop if sentinel changes affect a public API or persisted representation without compatibility handling.

records.title: Python exception, context, and resource lifecycle
records.goal: preserve exception context and deterministically release files, locks, sessions, and generators
detect: Find broad catches, swallowed exceptions, raise-without-chaining, manual close paths, and generator cleanup gaps.
Trace ownership across normal return, exception, cancellation, and partial initialization.
records.fix: Use narrow exception handling and context management at the resource owner.
records.verify: Test success and each failure edge while asserting cleanup and preserved exception cause.
records.stop: Stop if changing exception types would break a documented caller contract.

records.title: Python asyncio task cancellation and timeouts
records.goal: eliminate orphaned tasks, swallowed cancellation, and unbounded awaits
detect: Trace create_task ownership, TaskGroup use, cancellation propagation, timeout boundaries, and blocking calls.
Find background tasks held only weakly or exceptions never observed.
records.fix: Use structured task ownership, explicit timeout boundaries, and finally cleanup while re-propagating cancellation.
records.verify: Test cancellation at each await, timeout expiry, child failure, shutdown, and task completion.
records.stop: Stop if task lifetime is intentionally process-global but has no documented owner.

records.title: Python import, packaging, and module boundaries
records.goal: remove import cycles and make package exports and runtime discovery explicit
detect: Map imports, __init__ exports, entry points, namespace packages, import-time side effects, and optional extras.
Distinguish type-only cycles from runtime cycles and plugin discovery.
records.fix: Move shared contracts to stable modules and make exports and optional boundaries explicit.
records.verify: Build wheels and sdists, install into a clean environment, import public modules, and run entry points.
records.stop: Stop on undocumented plugin loading or packaging behavior not covered by a clean-install test.

records.title: Java compiler warning, deprecation, and suppression debt
records.goal: resolve javac warnings and narrow SuppressWarnings annotations
detect: Read Maven or Gradle compiler settings and inventory lint categories, deprecations, unchecked operations, and suppressions.
Confirm source, target, release, and minimum runtime compatibility.
records.fix: Replace deprecated or unchecked constructs and scope justified suppressions to the smallest declaration.
records.verify: Compile with repository lint settings and run affected tests across supported JDKs.
records.stop: Stop if the replacement drops a supported JDK or changes a public binary contract.

records.title: Java nullability, Optional, and boundary contracts
records.goal: make null contracts explicit without misusing Optional in storage or fields
detect: Trace nullable inputs, dereferences, annotations, Optional creation, serialization, persistence, and framework injection.
Identify conflicting package-level and external nullness conventions.
records.fix: Validate at boundaries and use annotations or Optional only where they reflect the actual API contract.
records.verify: Run nullness analysis and tests for null, absent, empty, and framework-created values.
records.stop: Stop if annotation changes alter a published API contract without consumer review.

records.title: Java AutoCloseable and resource lifecycle
records.goal: close files, streams, clients, cursors, and scopes on every exit path
detect: Find AutoCloseable creation and trace ownership through returns, exceptions, wrappers, and asynchronous work.
Identify close ordering, suppressed exceptions, and resources escaping their intended scope.
records.fix: Use try-with-resources or an explicit owner whose lifetime matches the escaped resource.
records.verify: Test normal, partial-init, exception, and early-return paths while asserting closure order.
records.stop: Stop if ownership is shared or framework-managed and its lifecycle contract is unclear.

records.title: Java executor, Future, and ThreadLocal lifecycle
records.goal: bound background work and clean executor and thread-local state
detect: Trace executor creation, queue bounds, Future observation, cancellation, shutdown, and ThreadLocal removal.
Find common-pool blocking and per-request state crossing reused threads.
records.fix: Assign explicit ownership, propagate cancellation, bound queues, observe failures, and clear thread-local state.
records.verify: Test saturation, cancellation, task failure, shutdown, and request reuse.
records.stop: Stop if changing concurrency limits requires capacity or latency decisions from an owner.

records.title: Kotlin compiler, Detekt, and suppression debt
records.goal: resolve Kotlin diagnostics and narrow file or declaration suppressions
detect: Read compiler, Gradle, and Detekt settings and inventory warnings, baseline entries, and Suppress annotations.
Separate generated sources and Java interop warnings from owned Kotlin code.
records.fix: Use idiomatic Kotlin constructs and shrink suppressions without enabling broad auto-correction.
records.verify: Run the configured compiler and Detekt tasks plus focused tests.
records.stop: Stop if automatic changes alter serialization, ABI, or Java-callable signatures.

records.title: Kotlin coroutine scope, cancellation, and Flow lifecycle
records.goal: replace orphaned coroutines and uncollected or multiply collected flows with owned lifecycles
detect: Trace scope creation, Job parentage, dispatcher use, cancellation, exception handlers, and Flow collection.
Find GlobalScope, blocking calls, leaked collectors, and swallowed CancellationException.
records.fix: Attach work to structured scopes, preserve cancellation, and make collection ownership explicit.
records.verify: Test child failure, parent cancellation, timeout, collector restart, and lifecycle teardown.
records.stop: Stop if scope ownership depends on undocumented application or framework lifecycle.

records.title: Kotlin nullability, platform types, and immutability
records.goal: contain Java platform types and remove unsafe assertions and unintended mutation
detect: Find platform types, double-bang assertions, unsafe casts, mutable collection exposure, and data-class copy assumptions.
Trace Java interop annotations and framework-created values.
records.fix: Narrow at interop boundaries and expose immutable contracts while preserving required framework mutability.
records.verify: Run compiler checks and tests for null Java returns, collection aliasing, and serialization.
records.stop: Stop if changing mutability or nullability alters a public Java or Kotlin API.

records.title: .NET nullable and analyzer suppression debt
records.goal: resolve nullable and analyzer warnings without null-forgiving or pragma expansion
detect: Read project, Directory.Build, and editorconfig settings and inventory nullable warnings, pragmas, and global suppressions.
Separate generated code and external annotations from application contracts.
records.fix: Add truthful annotations, guards, initialization, or analyzer-compliant code at the narrowest boundary.
records.verify: Build with configured analyzers and run focused tests with no new suppressions.
records.stop: Stop if annotations change a public contract or suppression rationale cannot be verified.

records.title: .NET async cancellation and fire-and-forget lifecycle
records.goal: propagate CancellationToken and observe every Task failure
detect: Trace Task creation, awaiting, token flow, timeout ownership, async void, and background service lifetime.
Find sync-over-async and tasks whose exceptions are never observed.
records.fix: Return or own tasks explicitly, propagate tokens, and isolate approved background work behind a supervised service.
records.verify: Test cancellation, timeout, exception, shutdown, and synchronization-context-sensitive paths.
records.stop: Stop if changing async signatures breaks a public interface or framework callback contract.

records.title: .NET disposable and async-disposable lifecycle
records.goal: dispose synchronous and asynchronous resources exactly once after their final use
detect: Trace IDisposable and IAsyncDisposable ownership across factories, DI scopes, returns, exceptions, and unawaited tasks.
Identify double-dispose, early-dispose, and framework-owned services.
records.fix: Use using or await using at the true owner and preserve DI/container lifecycle rules.
records.verify: Test success, exception, cancellation, partial initialization, and final asynchronous flush.
records.stop: Stop when ownership belongs to a container or caller and cannot be proven locally.

records.title: .NET LINQ enumeration and EF query boundaries
records.goal: avoid repeated enumeration, client evaluation, N+1 loading, and leaked query lifetimes
detect: Trace IQueryable versus IEnumerable transitions, materialization points, repeated enumeration, includes, and per-row queries.
Inspect DbContext lifetime and transaction boundaries.
records.fix: Materialize deliberately, shape server-side queries, and batch related data without hiding query costs.
records.verify: Assert query counts and generated SQL where supported plus result, cancellation, and transaction tests.
records.stop: Stop if query changes need production data distribution or indexing decisions.

records.title: Go vet and lint suppression debt
records.goal: resolve Go diagnostics and narrow nolint directives
detect: Read module, workspace, build-tag, vet, and configured linter settings and inventory nolint directives.
Run diagnostics across relevant tags, platforms, and test packages.
records.fix: Correct owned diagnostics and require a specific rule and rationale for unavoidable suppressions.
records.verify: Run gofmt checks, go vet, configured linters, go test, and tagged builds.
records.stop: Stop if a diagnostic is generated code, platform-specific by design, or requires an API compatibility decision.

records.title: Go error wrapping and sentinel contracts
records.goal: preserve error identity and context without string matching or duplicate logging
detect: Trace error creation, wrapping, comparison, type assertion, logging, and translation at API boundaries.
Find formatting that drops identity and callers comparing error strings.
records.fix: Wrap with percent-w where identity is contractual and translate once at the owning boundary.
records.verify: Test `errors.Is`, `errors.As`, public status mapping, context, and absence of duplicate logs.
records.stop: Stop if changing sentinel identity would break downstream callers.

records.title: Go goroutine, context, cancellation, and leak hygiene
records.goal: give every goroutine and context a bounded owner and shutdown path
detect: Trace goroutine starts, context derivation, cancel calls, channel exits, timers, and WaitGroup or errgroup joins.
Find contexts stored in structs and goroutines blocked after caller cancellation.
records.fix: Propagate context, defer cancellation at the creator, and join or deliberately supervise every goroutine.
records.verify: Run cancellation and shutdown tests, leak checks if configured, and the race detector where supported.
records.stop: Stop if the goroutine is process-global without a documented supervisor or shutdown contract.

records.title: Go channel, lock, and shared-state hygiene
records.goal: remove channel ownership ambiguity, lock misuse, and data races
detect: Map shared variables, lock scopes, channel creators, senders, closers, and blocking operations.
Use the race detector on representative concurrent paths.
records.fix: Assign one close owner, minimize shared mutation, and keep blocking or callback work outside locks.
records.verify: Run race-enabled focused tests plus cancellation, saturation, close, and shutdown cases.
records.stop: Stop if lock or channel redesign requires changing ordering or throughput contracts.

records.title: Rust Clippy lint baseline and allow debt
records.goal: resolve correctness and suspicious lints and narrow allow attributes
detect: Read Cargo lint tables, clippy configuration, MSRV, feature matrix, and allow or expect attributes.
Separate generated code and intentional restriction-lint policy from owned warnings.
records.fix: Correct diagnostics and scope justified lint levels to the smallest item with rationale.
records.verify: Run cargo fmt check, Clippy with repository features and targets, and focused tests.
records.stop: Stop before enabling whole pedantic or restriction groups or breaking the documented MSRV.

records.title: Rust panic, unwrap, expect, and error boundaries
records.goal: keep recoverable failures out of panic paths while preserving invariants
detect: Inventory unwrap, expect, panic, indexing, assertions, and error conversion by binary, library, test, and invariant boundary.
Classify impossible states versus input, I/O, configuration, and concurrency failures.
records.fix: Return or propagate typed errors for recoverable cases and document true invariant assertions.
records.verify: Test invalid input, dependency failure, boundary conversion, and invariant-preserving success paths.
records.stop: Stop if changing a public error type or panic contract requires downstream coordination.

records.title: Rust unsafe block and safety-invariant hygiene
records.goal: minimize unsafe scope and make every safety invariant locally reviewable
detect: Inventory unsafe blocks, functions, impls, FFI boundaries, raw pointer lifetimes, aliasing, and layout assumptions.
Require a concrete invariant for each operation rather than a block-level assertion.
records.fix: Move safe checks outside, shrink unsafe regions, and document caller and callee obligations next to operations.
records.verify: Run tests, Miri or sanitizers when configured, and boundary cases for layout, aliasing, and lifetime.
records.stop: Stop when soundness depends on undocumented foreign code, compiler behavior, or platform ABI.

records.title: Rust async cancellation, lock, and task lifecycle
records.goal: avoid detached tasks, locks across await, and cancellation-unsafe partial operations
detect: Trace spawn ownership, JoinHandle observation, select cancellation points, lock guards, and shutdown signals.
Find blocking operations and resource mutation spanning await points.
records.fix: Use structured task ownership, shorten guard scope, and make cancellation-safe state transitions.
records.verify: Test task failure, cancellation at each await, shutdown, lock contention, and partial progress.
records.stop: Stop if cancellation semantics or executor choice are part of an undocumented external contract.

records.title: C and C++ compiler warning and suppression debt
records.goal: resolve portable compiler diagnostics without blanket flags or pragmas
detect: Read build flags per compiler, target, configuration, and generated-code boundary and inventory pragmas.
Compare diagnostics across supported compilers and standards modes.
records.fix: Correct owned warnings and scope unavoidable compiler-specific suppression with documented rationale.
records.verify: Build supported targets and configurations with existing warning-as-error gates and tests.
records.stop: Stop if the change alters ABI, calling convention, packed layout, or unsupported compiler compatibility.

records.title: C and C++ ownership, RAII, and resource lifecycle
records.goal: make memory, file, socket, lock, and handle ownership explicit
detect: Trace allocation, acquisition, transfer, release, error jumps, destructors, and raw owning pointers.
Identify mismatched allocators, double release, leaks, and resources held beyond need.
records.fix: Use scoped cleanup or RAII owners and express transfers without changing non-owning views.
records.verify: Run focused failure-path tests and configured leak, address, or resource sanitizers.
records.stop: Stop when ownership crosses an undocumented C ABI or third-party callback boundary.

records.title: C and C++ bounds, integer, and undefined-behavior hygiene
records.goal: remove unchecked bounds, lossy arithmetic, lifetime, and undefined-behavior hazards
detect: Trace lengths, offsets, signedness, narrowing, pointer arithmetic, shifts, overflow assumptions, and object lifetimes.
Exercise parser and allocation boundaries with sanitizer-supported inputs.
records.fix: Validate before arithmetic, use suitable types and checked operations, and preserve object lifetime rules.
records.verify: Run boundary tests, fuzz targets if present, and address and undefined-behavior sanitizers.
records.stop: Stop if wire format, ABI width, or performance constraints make the safe representation unclear.

records.title: C and C++ atomic, lock, and thread lifecycle
records.goal: remove data races, lock-order hazards, and detached thread lifetimes
detect: Map shared mutable state, synchronization, memory order, lock order, callbacks under locks, and thread join ownership.
Use configured thread-safety analysis or race detection on representative workloads.
records.fix: Prefer scoped locking and task ownership, minimize sharing, and use the weakest proven-correct atomic ordering only with rationale.
records.verify: Run race-enabled concurrent tests, shutdown cases, saturation, and repeated start-stop cycles.
records.stop: Stop if lock-free correctness or memory ordering lacks a documented proof and specialist review.

records.title: C and C++ const, span, view, and lifetime hygiene
records.goal: make mutation and non-owning view lifetimes explicit
detect: Find raw pointer-length pairs, dangling views, temporaries bound to references, unnecessary mutation, and const casts.
Trace container reallocation and owner lifetime past every span or view use.
records.fix: Use explicit owner and view types with const-correct interfaces and lifetime-safe call structure.
records.verify: Run tests under sanitizers and exercise empty, temporary, reallocated, and moved-owner cases.
records.stop: Stop if interface changes affect ABI or callers outside the repository.

records.title: Ruby RuboCop baseline and disable debt
records.goal: resolve RuboCop offenses and narrow disabled cops without broad rewrites
detect: Read inherited RuboCop configuration, target Ruby version, generated paths, TODO baselines, and inline disables.
Separate safe autocorrect candidates from behavior-changing or framework-sensitive cops.
records.fix: Apply reviewed local corrections and remove stale baseline entries without broad unsafe autocorrect.
records.verify: Run RuboCop with the repository config and focused tests under the supported Ruby version.
records.stop: Stop if autocorrection changes metaprogramming, DSL, serialization, or public behavior.

records.title: Rails query, transaction, and callback hygiene
records.goal: make Active Record query count, transaction scope, and callback side effects explicit
detect: Trace relation materialization, associations, per-row queries, transactions, callbacks, validations, and after-commit work.
Identify callbacks whose network or queue side effects occur before commit.
records.fix: Preload or batch intentionally and move side effects to an explicit post-commit owner.
records.verify: Assert query counts, rollback behavior, callback ordering, and representative result sets.
records.stop: Stop if indexing, production data distribution, or domain transaction semantics require owner decisions.

records.title: PHP strict types, static analysis, and suppression debt
records.goal: narrow mixed values and static-analysis suppressions without breaking framework boundaries
detect: Read PHP version, analyzer configuration and baseline, strict_types use, docblocks, mixed values, and ignores.
Separate framework magic and generated code from application-owned contracts.
records.fix: Add truthful parameter, return, property, shape, or assertion types at owned boundaries.
records.verify: Run syntax checks, the configured analyzer, and focused tests with no broader baseline.
records.stop: Stop if strict types or signatures would break public consumers or framework invocation.

records.title: PHP exception, stream, and resource lifecycle
records.goal: close resources and preserve failure context across PHP request and worker paths
detect: Trace fopen and stream resources, database handles, locks, temporary files, catches, finally blocks, and worker reuse.
Find swallowed Throwable values and cleanup that only occurs on normal return.
records.fix: Place cleanup at the owning scope and catch only failures the layer can translate or recover from.
records.verify: Test normal, warning-to-exception, partial initialization, worker repetition, and failure cleanup paths.
records.stop: Stop if resource ownership is extension-managed or framework-managed and undocumented.

records.title: Swift warning, deprecation, and force-unwrap debt
records.goal: resolve compiler warnings and unsafe optionals without obscuring invariants
detect: Read Swift language mode and deployment targets and inventory warnings, unavailable APIs, force unwraps, casts, and try-bang.
Classify proven invariants separately from user, network, persistence, and framework values.
records.fix: Use guarded optional handling or documented invariant assertions and availability-compatible replacements.
records.verify: Build all supported targets and test nil, unavailable, malformed, and success paths.
records.stop: Stop if replacement requires increasing deployment target or changing a public Swift or Objective-C API.

records.title: Swift actor, Sendable, and task lifecycle
records.goal: resolve isolation violations, unsafe sharing, and unowned tasks
detect: Trace actor isolation, Sendable crossings, detached tasks, task groups, cancellation, and main-actor work.
Find shared mutable captures and tasks outliving their UI or service owner.
records.fix: Move state behind the correct actor and attach work to a structured cancellable owner.
records.verify: Build with configured concurrency checking and test cancellation, teardown, actor hops, and repeated lifecycle.
records.stop: Stop if actor reassignment changes UI responsiveness or a public concurrency contract.

records.title: Dart analyzer, null-safety, and ignore debt
records.goal: resolve analyzer diagnostics and remove unsafe null assertions and broad ignores
detect: Read analysis_options, SDK constraints, generated exclusions, ignore comments, dynamic values, casts, and bang assertions.
Separate plugin and platform-channel boundaries from application-owned types.
records.fix: Use flow analysis, typed models, and narrow boundary validation without weakening analyzer rules.
records.verify: Run dart format check, analyze, and focused tests under the constrained SDK.
records.stop: Stop if the fix raises the SDK floor or changes a published package API.

records.title: Flutter Future, stream, controller, and widget lifecycle
records.goal: cancel subscriptions and dispose controllers and async work with the owning widget or service
detect: Trace subscriptions, timers, controllers, focus nodes, animations, futures, mounted checks, and dispose ordering.
Find callbacks that call setState after teardown or retain State objects.
records.fix: Assign lifecycle ownership, cancel or dispose symmetrically, and guard unavoidable asynchronous completion.
records.verify: Run widget tests for mount, update, navigation away, cancellation, error, and repeated creation.
records.stop: Stop if ownership belongs to a state-management container whose lifecycle is not visible.

records.title: ShellCheck quoting and word-splitting hygiene
records.goal: remove unintended expansion, globbing, and argument-boundary bugs
detect: Run the repository's ShellCheck dialect and trace variable, command, array, glob, here-document, and positional expansion.
Distinguish deliberate splitting from accidental argument flattening.
records.fix: Quote expansions or use arrays and explicit read loops while preserving intended glob semantics.
records.verify: Test empty, whitespace, wildcard, newline, dash-prefixed, and non-ASCII arguments in supported shells.
records.stop: Stop if the script intentionally relies on implementation-specific splitting without tests.

records.title: Shell exit, pipeline, trap, and temporary-file lifecycle
records.goal: propagate failures and clean temporary state on every signal and exit
detect: Trace pipeline status, subshells, command substitutions, conditional exceptions, traps, mktemp use, and cleanup ownership.
Check actual target-shell behavior rather than assuming one strict-mode policy.
records.fix: Handle expected failures explicitly and install idempotent cleanup for owned temporary resources.
records.verify: Test each command failure, interrupted execution, partial setup, spaces in paths, and successful cleanup.
records.stop: Stop before adopting shell options incompatible with supported shells or sourced-script callers.

records.title: PowerShell ScriptAnalyzer and suppression debt
records.goal: resolve PSScriptAnalyzer findings and narrow rule exclusions
detect: Read analyzer settings, target editions and versions, module manifests, suppressions, and compatibility rules.
Separate generated code and intentional public command naming from fixable diagnostics.
records.fix: Use approved PowerShell patterns and scope justified suppressions to a named rule and declaration.
records.verify: Run Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer with repository settings plus module import and Pester tests if present.
records.stop: Stop if a change breaks exported command names or supported Windows PowerShell compatibility.

records.title: PowerShell error, output, and resource lifecycle
records.goal: make terminating behavior, pipeline output, and disposable resources predictable
detect: Trace ErrorAction, preference variables, try-catch-finally, native exit codes, Write-Output leakage, streams, jobs, and runspaces.
Find functions mixing data output with status text or losing native failures.
records.fix: Use explicit terminating boundaries, correct output streams, and deterministic job or resource cleanup.
records.verify: Test native and cmdlet failures, pipeline composition, WhatIf where supported, cancellation, and cleanup.
records.stop: Stop if error semantics are part of a public module contract without consumer tests.

records.title: SQL migration idempotence and rollback hygiene
records.goal: make schema migrations ordered, restartable where required, and operationally reversible
detect: Inspect migration framework ordering, transactional DDL support, backfills, locks, defaults, and deploy sequencing.
Classify expand, migrate, contract, irreversible, and data-loss operations.
records.fix: Split incompatible changes into bounded forward-safe steps and document honest rollback or roll-forward behavior.
records.verify: Apply from a prior schema, retry interrupted steps where supported, and validate application compatibility before and after.
records.stop: Stop on destructive changes, unknown table scale, or lock duration requiring database-owner approval.

records.title: SQL transaction, locking, and concurrency hygiene
records.goal: make transaction scope and concurrent update behavior explicit
detect: Trace transaction begin and end, isolation, lock order, retries, read-modify-write sequences, and external calls inside transactions.
Identify lost-update, deadlock, long-transaction, and partial-commit paths.
records.fix: Shorten transactions, use appropriate atomic operations, and add bounded retry only for identified transient conflicts.
records.verify: Run concurrent tests for conflict, deadlock, retry, rollback, and invariant preservation.
records.stop: Stop if selecting isolation or lock behavior requires production workload evidence.

records.title: SQL query plan, index, and N+1 hygiene
records.goal: remove proven query amplification and plan regressions using representative evidence
detect: Capture query count, parameterized SQL, representative EXPLAIN output, row estimates, scans, joins, and sort or spill behavior.
Distinguish application N+1 calls from a single intentionally repeated query.
records.fix: Batch or reshape application access first and propose indexes only when predicates and workload justify them.
records.verify: Compare result sets, query counts, plans, and representative timing without relying on tiny fixtures alone.
records.stop: Stop before adding or removing indexes without table size, write cost, and production-owner review.

records.title: Terraform format, validation, and provider-lock hygiene
records.goal: keep configuration canonical and provider resolution reproducible
detect: Inventory Terraform versions, required providers, lock hashes, modules, generated configuration, and workspace boundaries.
Run formatting and validation without accessing remote backends where possible.
records.fix: Apply canonical formatting and regenerate lock metadata only with the declared toolchain and intended platforms.
records.verify: Run fmt check, init with backend disabled where suitable, validate, and a reviewed plan for affected roots.
records.stop: Stop on provider upgrades, backend access, lock hash provenance uncertainty, or state mutation.

records.title: Terraform state-address and refactor safety
records.goal: preserve resource identity through module and address refactors
detect: Map current and desired resource addresses, for_each keys, module paths, imports, moved blocks, and state ownership.
Identify destroy-create plans caused only by address changes.
records.fix: Use declarative moved blocks or an operator-reviewed state procedure without applying it automatically.
records.verify: Produce a plan showing address moves and no unintended create, destroy, or replacement actions.
records.stop: Stop before state commands, apply, import, or ambiguous many-to-one address mapping.

records.title: Dockerfile layer, cache, and build-context hygiene
records.goal: make container builds reproducible, cache-efficient, and free of accidental context
detect: Inspect Dockerfile stage graph, context, dockerignore, copy order, package-manager caches, build arguments, and emitted artifacts.
Compare clean and cached builds and final-image contents.
records.fix: Narrow context and stages, order stable inputs before volatile inputs, and remove build-only material from final stages.
records.verify: Run clean and cached builds, inspect final files and history, and execute existing image tests.
records.stop: Stop before changing base versions, package versions, registry, signing, or release provenance.

records.title: Container signal, healthcheck, and shutdown hygiene
records.goal: make PID 1 signal handling, readiness, health, and graceful shutdown correct
detect: Trace entrypoint form, PID 1, child processes, signal forwarding, grace periods, health commands, and open listeners.
Distinguish readiness from liveness and startup completion.
records.fix: Use direct exec or an appropriate init and align health behavior with actual service lifecycle.
records.verify: Start the image, send termination, observe exit and child cleanup, and test health transitions.
records.stop: Stop if changing grace periods or health semantics requires orchestrator or SLO owner approval.

records.title: Kubernetes schema, deprecation, and selector drift
records.goal: remove deprecated fields and prevent selector and label contract drift
detect: Render manifests and inspect apiVersion, schema validation, immutable selectors, labels, patches, CRDs, and target cluster versions.
Compare base and overlay outputs rather than editing templates in isolation.
records.fix: Use supported APIs and align labels and selectors without changing resource identity unintentionally.
records.verify: Render every overlay and run server-side or version-matched validation without applying resources.
records.stop: Stop if migration changes immutable fields, CRDs, resource identity, or requires cluster access.

records.title: Kubernetes probe, resource, and rollout hygiene
records.goal: make probes, resources, disruption, and rollout settings internally consistent
detect: Inspect startup, readiness, and liveness probes; requests and limits; termination grace; strategy; disruption budgets; and autoscaling inputs.
Relate probe endpoints to actual dependency and startup behavior visible in code.
records.fix: Correct contradictory or clearly invalid configuration while leaving capacity and SLO choices to owners.
records.verify: Render and validate manifests and test probe endpoints and graceful shutdown locally where possible.
records.stop: Stop before choosing production resource values, availability budgets, or rollout percentages without operational evidence.

records.title: CI workflow timeout, concurrency, and cache hygiene
records.goal: bound CI jobs and prevent stale caches and duplicate workflow races
detect: Map triggers, permissions, job dependencies, timeouts, concurrency groups, cancellation, matrices, cache keys, and artifact lifetimes.
Identify redundant runs and caches missing lockfile, platform, or toolchain inputs.
records.fix: Add bounded timeouts, safe concurrency cancellation, and deterministic cache keys without changing release authority.
records.verify: Validate workflow syntax and exercise pull-request, branch, retry, and cache-hit or miss paths where tooling permits.
records.stop: Stop before changing secrets, permissions, release triggers, protected environments, or third-party action trust.
